findings.evidence: `TensorProduct.finsuppScalarRight` at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/DirectSum/Finsupp.lean:167 and `MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv` at Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Module.lean:75 have no `[DecidableEq]` parameter; the affected definitions are already `noncomputable`, and later proofs at lines 357 and 374 demonstrate the standard local-`classical` approach.
findings.fix: Remove the section-level instance and use `classical` locally in proofs that need equality decisions; retain `[DecidableEq G]` only for `isInternal_weightSpace`, whose `DirectSum.IsInternal` type itself requires it.
findings.issue: The section-level `[DecidableEq G]` unnecessarily strengthens `tensorCoeffEquiv`, `tensorCoeffEquiv_apply`, `tensorCoeffEquiv_tmul`, `tensorCoeffEquiv_symm_single`, `weightDecomposition`, `weightDecomposition_apply`, `coact_eq_symm_weightDecomposition`, and `weightDecomposition_sum`.

summary: The coefficient-family API unnecessarily requires decidable equality on the weight index, despite being noncomputable and built from APIs that impose no such assumption.
